messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Usual Adult Dose for Depression:
Initial dose: 150 mg orally per day in divided doses; this may be increased by 50 mg orally per day every 3 to 4 days Maximum dose: -Inpatients: 600 mg/day -Outpatients: 400 mg/day Comments: -Patients should be screened for a personal/family history of bipolar disorder, mania, or hypomania prior to initiating treatment. -Patients should be monitored for withdrawal symptoms when discontinuing therapy. -After an adequate response has been reached, dosage may be gradually reduced depending on therapeutic response. -If drowsiness develops, a major portion of the daily dose may be administered at bedtime or a reduction of dosage may be necessary. -This drug should be taken shortly after a meal or light snack. Use: Treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD)
Triplet: ["Trazodone", "has dose increase", "50 mg orally per day every 3 to 4 days"]

The relation 'has dose increase' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's dose can be increased by the amount specified by the object entity at the frequency indicated.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has administration frequency': The subject drug is administered at the frequency specified by the object entity.
B. 'dose depends on': The subject drug's dose is determined by the factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dose increase instruction for pediatric': The subject drug has a specific instruction for increasing the dose in pediatric patients as specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
F. None of the above.
